prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal engineering-investigation notes for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset. For each engagement in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence FINDING_SUMMARY an engineer would log for that activity type and suspected root cause, in plain engineering language. Do not invent facts beyond what's given. Vary tone/length.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"engagements": [{"i": <int>, "finding_summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 2415, 'activity_type': 'product_defect_confirmation', 'root_cause': 'product defect', 'component': 'Accessibility Layer', 'product': 'Feedback Collector'}, {'i': 2416, 'activity_type': 'repro_attempt', 'root_cause': 'product defect', 'component': 'In-App Messaging Widget', 'product': 'Customer Portal'}, {'i': 2417, 'activity_type': 'product_defect_confirmation', 'root_cause': 'product defect', 'component': 'In-App Messaging Widget', 'product': 'Customer Portal'}, {'i': 2418, 'activity_type': 'bug_investigation', 'root_cause': 'incomplete migration', 'component': 'Identity Lifecycle Manager', 'product': 'SSO Integration Module'}, {'i': 2419, 'activity_type': 'product_defect_confirmation', 'root_cause': 'schema mismatch', 'component': 'Event Schema Registry', 'product': 'Analytics Dashboard'}]
